??? quote "Dialogue"

    - There are rocks under the Jaw, on the inside, where a pilot boat can lie out of the run and wait on a turn. We call it the lee. Every pilot in this town has sat there wet through.
    - Maili and I sat there the first summer I had a boat. She brought bread and complained about the wind the whole tide. Best day I remember.
    - Kor tells me the crabs have taken the lee. Crabs as big as a cartwheel, on the rocks where a tired boat puts in. A boat that runs in there in a hurry will have her planks stove in.
    - Get out to the **Forest Jaw** and clear **60 [Jaw Crab](../monsters/jaw_crab.md)s** off it. My knees will not take me there. Yours will.
    - Past the Wrack Ledges, at the cliff foot. It is a walk. Take bread.
    - Then the pilots will lie off and get wet. They have before.
    - Sixty [Jaw Crab](../monsters/jaw_crab.md)s on the Forest Jaw. Don't get pinched.
    - Clear? Aye.
    - That is the first time in five years I have sent anyone out to the Jaw who did not come back complaining. Take these. And when you sit on those rocks, sit on the flat one. That one was hers.
